conventions.prop: prop.R/prop.L joint frame == held item frame (glTF identity attach)
conventions.inPlace: no root motion except ZeroG attitude on root
conventions.events: footstep (side), fire, hit, grab, release, contact, spark, mag_out, mag_in
conventions.supportIK: [first, last] frame ranges where hand.L holds the item's socket.support

hip.R.note: holstered item frame used by the draw/holster clips: item +Y (forward) and +Z (up) in Blender armature axes of the rest pose, origin = socket position + offset; the clip moves prop.R there while holstered

hip.L.note: holstered item frame used by the draw/holster clips: item +Y (forward) and +Z (up) in Blender armature axes of the rest pose, origin = socket position + offset; the clip moves prop.R there while holstered

back.note: holstered item frame used by the draw/holster clips: item +Y (forward) and +Z (up) in Blender armature axes of the rest pose, origin = socket position + offset; the clip moves prop.R there while holstered

belt.note: holstered item frame used by the draw/holster clips: item +Y (forward) and +Z (up) in Blender armature axes of the rest pose, origin = socket position + offset; the clip moves prop.R there while holstered
